scope: One synthetic baseline stroke, native host Mesa RGBA8 capture with explicit RTV1 call sequence and Draw XY scale 2, compared with test-only Rust Scene candidate SVG and native PDF exports. Not device, saved-note, PDF native, or general transform parity.
method: Both modes apply 2x XY scale about (128,128) to output geometry. Fixed computes analytic derivatives in unit-scale coordinates as in the existing candidate; aware computes them in 2x screen coordinates. Only that derivative input changes between modes; the same subdivision, alpha formula, Scene export and raster comparison are used. The isolated patch removes unit-scale path-count assertions because the scale-aware alpha cutoff changes emitted counts.
metrics: [native support, export support, intersection, union, RGB L1 on union]; support differs from 252 by more than 2 in any channel. resvg SVG and PyMuPDF PDF raster at 256x256; PDF 96dpi page rasterized at 4/3.
